level_and_variant_inventory.rule: For each included id, every normal and permanent variant level listed by the pinned normalized catalogue is in scope. The catalogue's per-level provenance, modes and fields are the authoritative level inventory; this manifest fixes membership rather than duplicating mutable values.

electromite.reason: Required Home Village spawned subunit identified by the Super Yeti mechanics audit, but absent from the frozen normalized catalogue. It remains inventory-visible without a fabricated GameData, Core, GUI, RL, snapshot or asset entry.

big_boy.reason: Required Home Village spawned subunit identified by the Super Witch mechanics audit, but absent from the frozen normalized catalogue. It remains inventory-visible without a fabricated GameData, Core, GUI, RL, snapshot or asset entry.

witch_skeleton.reason: Required Home Village spawned subunit identified by the dated Witch delta, but no reproducible current stat table or deterministic summoning lifecycle is available. It remains inventory-visible without a fabricated GameData, Core, GUI, RL, snapshot or asset entry.

lava_pup.reason: Required Home Village spawned subunit recorded by the dated Lava Hound delta, but no reproducible current stat table or deterministic death-split lifecycle is available.

meteormite.reason: Required permanent Home Village child recorded by the dated Meteor Golem delta. Current child values after the official July 2026 buff and a deterministic split and merge lifecycle are unavailable, so no GameData or generic proxy is fabricated.

temporary_crafted_defenses.reason: Crafted Defenses are temporary, phase-selected defenses. The permanent Crafting Station itself is included above.

non_building_troop_trap_combatants.reason: Guardians are neither buildings, troops, Super Troops, traps nor required spawned subunits in this goal.

goal_exclusions.reason: Explicitly outside the persistent goal; Clan Castle contents and reinforcements are excluded even though the targetable Clan Castle building is included.

completion_rule: Membership is not completion. Each included id must independently satisfy sourced data, Core behavior, headless, GUI, RL, documented asset and geometry, snapshot/replay, deterministic regression, and fidelity-evidence axes before it can be reported complete.
